# `aube cache prune`

- **Usage:** `aube cache prune [--age-days <AGE_DAYS>] [--dry-run]`
- **Effect:** modifies state

Remove stale extracted primer files from the metadata cache.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube cache prune --dry-run
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/registry-auth) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Flags

- **`--age-days <AGE_DAYS>`** — Minimum age in days before an old primer file is removed.

  **Default:** `30`
- **`--dry-run`** — Do not actually delete anything.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
